title: LEGS + BALANCE
subtitle: MONDAY START. KIND LEGS. STEADY FEET.

script.welcome: Good morning Pam. I'm Stratton. Monday is legs and balance — gentle and steady, about ten minutes. If a joint is sore today, take a smaller range. Showing up is the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Sit tall, easy breath. We'll start the week kindly.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Shake the legs out if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work, Pam. Strong legs, steady feet, and a fine start to the week. See you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED KNEE LIFTS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Lift one knee a little toward the ceiling, then set it down gently. Alternate sides with an easy rhythm. Soft hands on the seat edges if you like. A smaller lift is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated knee lifts to warm the hips and legs. Two sets of eight each leg. Sit tall, lift one knee a little, set it down gently. Easy rhythm. A smaller lift is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the hips. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Knee lifts done. Nicely warmed up.

exercises.name: SIT TO STAND
exercises.cue: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat and hip-width. Lean forward a little, press through the whole foot, and stand up tall. Then sit back down slowly with control. Use your hands on the seat or thighs to help any time. Stop short of any sharp knee pain; a smaller, slower stand is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Sit to stand for strong, kind legs. Two sets of five. Lean forward a little, press through your feet, stand up tall, then sit down slowly. Use your hands to help whenever you like.
exercises.speakRest: Thirty seconds. Sit back and breathe easy.
exercises.speakDone: Sit to stand done. Well done, that's real everyday strength.

exercises.name: CHAIR BALANCE
exercises.cue: Stand beside a sturdy chair, light fingertips on the backrest for support. Soft belly. Shift your weight onto one foot and lift the other foot just a little — a toe tap is plenty. Soft knee on the standing leg. Hold about fifteen seconds, then switch sides. Use more hand support any time; a smaller lift is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Chair balance. Two sets of about fifteen seconds each side. Light fingertips on the chair, soft belly, lift one foot just a little. Soft knee. More support is always fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Both feet down. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Balance done. Steady as a rock.

exercises.name: SEATED FORWARD REACH
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Hinge gently from the hips and reach the hands forward toward the shins only as far as feels kind, to ease the backs of the legs. Soft neck. Hold a gentle stretch, then come back up with control. A smaller reach is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated forward reach to stretch the legs to finish. Two holds of about twenty seconds. Hinge gently from the hips, reach only as far as feels kind. Soft neck. A smaller reach is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Sit tall and breathe easy.
exercises.speakDone: Forward reach done. That's the session — lovely work.
